original_test_intent: Acquire all-link XGMI receive eye-width and eye-height four-point margin evidence for system-level signal-integrity analysis.
original_method: Verify XGMI topology/health and immutable AMDXIO support, run the exact all-link command once under independent watchdog and health monitoring, validate every expected link/lane/direction artifact, preserve raw outputs, and apply only an engineer-approved EH/EW oracle.
manual_activity: XGMI SI/GPU owner approves tool/topology/safety and supplies lane EH/EW thresholds; engineer analyzes files and determines result.
required_inputs: Authoritative EH/EW reference and lane PASS/FAIL thresholds
Approved maintenance/load state and artifact schema
safety_requirements: Verify all links healthy and mapped before margining
Use independent OOB/watchdog and one approved run
Monitor XGMI errors, GPU resets, temperature and power
Abort on link loss, error burst, hang or platform threshold
Post-check topology/counters and retain evidence; never auto retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify files cover every expected link/lane/direction and retain raw hashes
Report collection completeness and metrics without inventing thresholds or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its general instruction identifies the right family but lacks exact parameters, topology completeness, safety and acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute the literal all-link XGMI four-point AMDXIO command once with pre/post topology/error snapshots and independently monitored abort/recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: `-all`, BER 10, error count 5, four-point mode and the four specified range/step pairs are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an expected link/lane manifest before execution, hash every produced artifact, then map EH/EW margins and health counters to each roster row for engineering evaluation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds completeness and safety while preserving the source's collection-first nature.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A complete collection may mark review execution successful but cannot establish DUT PASS without lane thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The Master criteria define artifact collection, not acceptable margin magnitude.

project_override_considerations: SI engineering must define XGMI lane/direction reference limits and whether any unsupported/unreported lane is FAIL, BLOCKED or invalid run.
expected_evidence: AMDXIO approval/hash and expected XGMI topology manifest
Pre/post link state, widths/rates and XGMI error counters
Raw AMDXIO artifact hashes and schema/version
Expected-versus-observed link/lane/direction completeness plus EH/EW table
Telemetry, post health, recovery/dispositions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and collection criteria are coherent, but they intentionally do not define quantitative signal-integrity acceptance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and collection contract are complete; missing lane thresholds are queued for engineering while review continues.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row202 Wistron-AMD GPU-00195-V002: provide authoritative per-link/lane XGMI eye-width and eye-height PASS/FAIL limits and reference data for the exact AMDXIO all-link four-point parameters, define missing/unsupported lane handling, and approve the signed tool, topology, watchdog, error/thermal abort and OOB recovery contract. Artifact collection alone must not be treated as DUT PASS.

review_improvement: Defines complete all-link/lane evidence and explicitly separates successful margin collection from an absent DUT acceptance oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: The four-point command can finish and emit files even when margin is poor; file existence proves only that measurement ran. Conversely, link/lane omissions can be lost if analysis iterates only over generated rows. An expected topology manifest is required before collection, and quantitative EH/EW limits must come from SI engineering rather than inferred from the command's step ranges.
